role: Architecture reference for Flo, the in-app AI assistant: turn lifecycle, providers, fact/tool registry, system prompt caching, routing, voice, speech normalization, hallucination guard, persistence, safety gates, memory, deterministic answers, Apple tool bridge, action bridges, tests, gotchas, telemetry.

units.key: § Flo — AI Assistant Architecture
units.does: no behavioural claim: title, source tree pointer and note that citations omit line numbers.

units.key: § Flo — AI Assistant Architecture > 1. What Flo Is
units.does: Claims six providers behind one protocol, tool use via a FactResolverRegistry, tiered routing only while Apple is selected, SFSpeechRecognizer/WhisperKit STT with AVSpeechSynthesizer TTS, UserFactsStore memory, stable/variable prompt split for caching, voice deterministic shortcuts, number-checking hallucination guard, per-provider consent. All confirmed in Assistant sources.

units.key: § Flo — AI Assistant Architecture > 2. System Diagram
units.does: System diagram: voice controller → AssistantViewModel.send (medical guard, consent, deterministic, dispatch) → TurnRouter/SmartProviderRouter → AssistantSystemPrompt → AIProvider.send stream → tool resolution via CompactToolRouter, text accumulation/speech, post-stream app-state check, CoachVoiceGuard scrub and fact extraction. Consistent with code.

units.key: § Flo — AI Assistant Architecture > 3. Turn Lifecycle
units.does: no behavioural claim: section header for turn lifecycle.

units.key: § Flo — AI Assistant Architecture > 3. Turn Lifecycle > 3.1 Input
units.does: Claims text sends call send(text:fromVoice: false) and voice finalizes a transcript then calls send with fromVoice: true.

units.key: § Flo — AI Assistant Architecture > 3. Turn Lifecycle > 3.2 `AssistantViewModel.send(text:fromVoice:)` — gating
units.does: Claims gate order: empty → rejectedEmpty; Flo off → rejectedNoProvider; medical guard (flag on, or self-harm always) appends a localOnly exchange; no key → rejectedNoProvider; consent required → requiresConsent; streaming → queued (latest wins); voice-only deterministic; else dispatchToProvider appends the user turn, sets nextSendIsVoice, prewarms Apple, dispatch(). Exactly matches send().

units.key: § Flo — AI Assistant Architecture > 3. Turn Lifecycle > 3.3 `dispatch()` — `AssistantViewModel+Routing.swift`
units.does: Claims dispatch() on AssistantTurnRouter routes, re-checks key/consent, reserves a placeholder turn, bumps streamGeneration and starts runDispatchedTurn, which refreshes metrics, assembles context (Apple compactRender, others none; truncateForSend; ToolRetriever targetK 40; trimTools), composes the prompt, runs the stream with error policy (guardrail refusals shown; fallbackable errors go to handleFallbackableFailure, which cuts orderedFallbackProviders to TurnRouter.failureFallback and shows PickedModelFailure when nothing is allowed, or the original error when every fallback fails), drops an empty turn, and if still the current generation clears the Apple registry and applies CoachVoiceGuard + background fact extraction, then finishStream(generation:) dispatches a queued message. Matches AssistantViewModel+Routing.swift:286-314,650-712.

units.key: § Flo — AI Assistant Architecture > 3. Turn Lifecycle > 3.4 `runToolUseLoop` — `AssistantViewModel+Tools.swift`
units.does: Claims runToolUseLoop streams rounds: textDelta appended with a 33 ms publish throttle, toolUse queued, usage logged with hit ratio, tool calls resolved through CompactToolRouter into ToolExchange rounds, max 8 calls per turn with synthetic missing results and one closing pass, and verifyAppStateNumbers at each round end. Matches (maxToolCallsPerTurn = 8).

units.key: § Flo — AI Assistant Architecture > 4. AssistantViewModel
units.does: Claims AssistantViewModel is @Observable @MainActor final class with static shared, lists state/API/SendOutcome cases, and that routing/streaming live on AssistantTurnRouter/AssistantToolRunner; resolvers run on the main actor with .sync/.awaitable bodies. Matches AssistantViewModel.swift:35-38, :335-344.

units.key: § Flo — AI Assistant Architecture > 5. Providers
units.does: no behavioural claim: section header for providers.

units.key: § Flo — AI Assistant Architecture > 5. Providers > 5.1 Protocol — `Emuqu/Sources/Assistant/Providers/AIProvider.swift`
units.does: Claims the AIProvider protocol shape (id, availableModels, requiresKey, isAvailable, maxToolSchemaCount, six-arg send returning AsyncThrowingStream<AIStreamEvent>), a four-arg extension send, AIStreamEvent cases, ProviderID cases and ModelOption fields.

units.key: § Flo — AI Assistant Architecture > 5. Providers > 5.2 Provider matrix
units.does: Provider matrix: Apple FoundationModels 4096 context; Anthropic cache_control ephemeral ttl 1h with extended-cache-ttl-2025-04-11 beta header; OpenAI reasoning_effort none; Gemini own builder; Grok maxToolSchemaCount 110; DeepSeek thinking disabled; ProviderStream.make maps cancellations/URLErrors so an offline turn fails the same way for every model, with whether another model may answer left to TurnRouter.failureFallback (§8.3); keys in Keychain via APIKeyStore. Spot-checked values match.

units.key: § Flo — AI Assistant Architecture > 6. Fact / Tool System
units.does: no behavioural claim: section intro (facts are reads, actions are writes).

units.key: § Flo — AI Assistant Architecture > 6. Fact / Tool System > 6.1 `FactValue` — `Emuqu/Sources/Assistant/Facts/FactValue.swift`
units.does: Claims FactValue cases, MissingReason cases (notRecorded … partialData), FactNumericArgument range validation returning invalidParameter, and Availability-based schema filtering. FactValue/MissingReason cases match FactValue.swift:19-124.

units.key: § Flo — AI Assistant Architecture > 6. Fact / Tool System > 6.2 `FactEntry` — `Emuqu/Sources/Assistant/Facts/FactCatalog.swift`
units.does: Claims FactEntry kinds .fixed/.parameterized/.composite/.action with the stated parameters and [ACTION] description prefix.

units.key: § Flo — AI Assistant Architecture > 6. Fact / Tool System > 6.3 `CompactToolRouter` — `Emuqu/Sources/Assistant/Facts/CompactToolRouter.swift
units.does: Claims CompactToolRouter.schema exposes 21 polymorphic read tools plus allowedActionNames actions, deduped by name and sorted; read results pass the registry's rate limit and size cap (gatedReadResult), slow reads logged not discarded; resolveTool refuses an action outside allowedActionNames; capabilityIndex for the cached prompt. Matches CompactToolRouter.swift:42-113 and FactResolverRegistry.gatedReadResult; allowedActionNames also includes assistant_artifacts_add/update_status, which the doc's list omits.

units.key: § Flo — AI Assistant Architecture > 6. Fact / Tool System > 6.4 Registry and namespaces
units.does: Claims AppFactResolverFactory.build returns a FactResolverRegistry with every FactNamespaceResolver namespace registered.

units.key: § Flo — AI Assistant Architecture > 6. Fact / Tool System > 6.5 Resolver time budget — `FactResolverRegistry`
units.does: Claims the registry times every resolve: over 0.5 s (resolveWarnBudgetSec) a warning, over 2 s (defaultResolveBudgetSec) a louder warning, value kept either way; actions over 4 s (watchdogWarnSec) log WATCHDOG-WARN; awaitable resolvers use FactResolveTimeout.withTimeout. Matches FactResolverRegistry.swift:260-268, logResolveDuration (406-412), logActionDuration (326-335), gatedReadResult (81-86).

units.key: § Flo — AI Assistant Architecture > 7. AssistantSystemPrompt — Cache-aware composition
units.does: Claims composeSplit returns stable/variable halves and compose joins them with cacheSplitMarker; Anthropic caches the stable block, others strip the marker.

units.key: § Flo — AI Assistant Architecture > 7. AssistantSystemPrompt — Cache-aware composition > 7.1 Stable sections (`stableSections`)
units.does: Lists stable sections: base, forced-English override, locale/units and disabled features, tool overlay + capabilityIndex (or non-tool overlay), voice overlay, knowledge base, UserFactsStore block.

units.key: § Flo — AI Assistant Architecture > 7. AssistantSystemPrompt — Cache-aware composition > 7.2 Variable sections (`variableSections`)
units.does: Lists variable sections: nowSnapshot, training-load numbers, active workout marker, MetricsVerifier pending corrections, dropped-turn summary, Apple rendered data block.

units.key: § Flo — AI Assistant Architecture > 8. Routing — `TurnRouter` and `SmartProviderRouter`
units.does: no behavioural claim: section header listing routing files.

units.key: § Flo — AI Assistant Architecture > 8. Routing — `TurnRouter` and `SmartProviderRouter` > 8.1 Tiers and modes
units.does: Claims routing acts only with Apple selected; Tier raw values 1/2/3; mapper quick → Apple, auto → consented Grok then DeepSeek else Apple, deep → same mid-tier; RoutingMode quick/deep pin, auto classifies, manual uses picker. Matches TurnRouter.preTierDecision and TierProviderMapper.

units.key: § Flo — AI Assistant Architecture > 8. Routing — `TurnRouter` and `SmartProviderRouter` > 8.2 Classification and stickiness (`.auto`)
units.does: Claims classify uses NLContextualEmbedding prototypes, falling back to NLEmbedding then keywords; four flags → tiers; stickiness rules (upgrade, first 3 turns, quick with no flags). Matches CapabilityClassifier.classify, SmartProviderRouter.embed and stickyTier (settlingTurns 3).

units.key: § Flo — AI Assistant Architecture > 8. Routing — `TurnRouter` and `SmartProviderRouter` > 8.3 Overrides
units.does: Claims overrides: voice bypass to first consented cloud when Apple selected; action-intent rerouting off Apple; 50/day deep cap; Apple guardrail refusals not retried elsewhere, context overflow retried once trimmed, other failures to the fallback chain as far as TurnRouter.failureFallback allows: none with a cloud model selected or in Manual (PickedModelFailure shown), Apple only in Quick, any accepted model in Auto/Deep in orderedFallbackProviders order (other clouds, Apple last). Matches TurnRouter.swift:294-331, AssistantViewModel+Routing.handleFallbackableFailure, AssistantViewModel+Tools.orderedFallbackProviders, SmartProviderRouter.dailyTier3Cap.

units.key: § Flo — AI Assistant Architecture > 9. Voice
units.does: no behavioural claim: section header for voice.

units.key: § Flo — AI Assistant Architecture > 9. Voice > 9.1 `VoiceConversationController`
units.does: Claims VoiceConversationController (@Observable @MainActor) has states idle/starting/listening/thinking/speaking/triggerSpeaking and forceFinalizeTurn for push-to-talk. Matches VoiceConversationController.swift:91-96 and +Speech.swift:184.

units.key: § Flo — AI Assistant Architecture > 9. Voice > 9.2 Speech-to-text — `Emuqu/Sources/Assistant/Chat/STTProvider.swift`
units.does: Claims STTProviderKind .apple (SFSpeechRecognizer) or .whisperKit chosen by UserSettings.preferredSTTProvider. Cases match STTProvider.swift:28-32.

units.key: § Flo — AI Assistant Architecture > 9. Voice > 9.3 Speech — `VoiceConversationController+Speech.swift`
units.does: Claims speak() applies coach-voice scrub, hallucination guard, first-chunk preamble, TTSTextNormalizer, at 0.96 × default rate with zero delays; SpokenTextChunker buffers sentences. Matches speak/makeUtterance.

units.key: § Flo — AI Assistant Architecture > 10. Speech Text Normalization
units.does: no behavioural claim: section header for speech normalization.

units.key: § Flo — AI Assistant Architecture > 10. Speech Text Normalization > 10.1 `TTSTextNormalizer.swift`
units.does: Claims normalize(_:english:) expands domain abbreviations, pace strings (bare 8:45 left alone) and years for English voices, then hands off to PhoneticOverrides.speechAttributedString.

units.key: § Flo — AI Assistant Architecture > 10. Speech Text Normalization > 10.2 `PhoneticOverrides.swift`
units.does: Claims PhoneticOverrides.resolve runs expandZipCodes, stripAuthoredMarkup ([[word|IPA]] → IPA attribute) and domainRules respellings skipping authored ranges.

units.key: § Flo — AI Assistant Architecture > 11. MetricsVerifier — Hallucination Guard
units.does: Claims MetricsVerifier.verify checks live-workout numbers, verifyAppStateClaims checks training-load/overnight numbers, recordCorrections buffers up to 4 deduped discrepancies and consumePendingCorrectionsBlock injects them into the next variable prompt. Cap of 4 stated at MetricsVerifier.swift:585.

units.key: § Flo — AI Assistant Architecture > 12. Conversation Persistence and Truncation
units.does: no behavioural claim: section header for persistence and truncation.

units.key: § Flo — AI Assistant Architecture > 12. Conversation Persistence and Truncation > 12.1 `ChatTurn` — `Emuqu/Sources/Assistant/Providers/AIProvider.swift`
units.does: Claims ChatTurn fields including subsystem and localOnly, with local-only turns never leaving the device.

units.key: § Flo — AI Assistant Architecture > 12. Conversation Persistence and Truncation > 12.2 `ConversationStore` — `Emuqu/Sources/Assistant/Chat/ConversationStore.swift
units.does: Claims ConversationStore writes Assistant/conversation.json atomically with .completeFileProtection in the App Group container, API load/save/clear/mergedWithDisk/retryHeldSave. Matches ConversationStore.swift:39,139.

units.key: § Flo — AI Assistant Architecture > 12. Conversation Persistence and Truncation > 12.3 Truncation — `Emuqu/Sources/Assistant/ViewModel/AssistantViewModel+Context.
units.does: Claims token budgets Apple 1200, DeepSeek 60000, others 80000, chars/4 estimate, truncateForSend drops oldest and keeps newest, and updateSummaryWith asks for ≤ 120 words with a 5 s timeout. Matches AssistantViewModel+Context.swift:98-151, :30, :75.

units.key: § Flo — AI Assistant Architecture > 13. Safety Gates
units.does: no behavioural claim: section header for safety gates.

units.key: § Flo — AI Assistant Architecture > 13. Safety Gates > 13.1 `MedicalQueryGuard.swift`
units.does: Claims MedicalQueryGuard refuses self-harm, acute symptoms, injury, heart-rhythm and risk-judgement questions in that order, locally, gated by medicalGuardEnabled except self-harm. Matches classify order (selfHarm, emergency, injury, rhythm, generalConcern) and send's gate.

units.key: § Flo — AI Assistant Architecture > 13. Safety Gates > 13.2 `ProviderConsentTracker.swift`
units.does: Claims Apple is consent-exempt and cloud consent is stored in UserDefaults key assistant.consent.v<consentSchemaVersion>.<provider>. Matches ProviderConsentTracker.swift:76-79 (version 8).

units.key: § Flo — AI Assistant Architecture > 13. Safety Gates > 13.3 `CoachVoiceGuard.swift`
units.does: Claims CoachVoiceGuard.scrub replaces whole sentences with neutral deflections and runs per streamed sentence, per utterance and on the final message.

units.key: § Flo — AI Assistant Architecture > 13. Safety Gates > 13.4 Prompt-level boundary
units.does: Claims base prompt opens with an information-access principle followed by a narrow MEDICAL BOUNDARY; local guard applies if ignored.

units.key: § Flo — AI Assistant Architecture > 14. UserFactsStore — Cross-session memory
units.does: Claims UserFactsStore persists Assistant/user_facts.json with add (case-normalized dedupe), remove, clear (erases everything including the backup), clearKeepingBackup/restoreCleared (the assistant's wipe and its undo, copy in memory until the app quits), systemPromptBlock. Matches UserFactsStore.swift.

units.key: § Flo — AI Assistant Architecture > 14. UserFactsStore — Cross-session memory > 14.1 Auto-extraction
units.does: Claims runAutoFactExtraction runs in background when enabled, prefers Apple, checks consent, asks for {"facts": [...]}, 8 s timeout, filters candidates. Timeout matches AssistantViewModel+Context.swift:182.

units.key: § Flo — AI Assistant Architecture > 14. UserFactsStore — Cross-session memory > 14.2 Model-driven memory
units.does: Claims assistant.memory.add/.remove/.clear/.restore actions let the model edit memory (allowedActionNames includes assistant_memory_*); .remove/.clear (and contacts.remove) record a pending request and return an app-written question on the first call, running when the same call returns after the user's explicit yes (AssistantActionConfirmations); .restore undoes the last confirmed clear.

units.key: § Flo — AI Assistant Architecture > 15. DeterministicIntent — No-model answers
units.does: Claims DeterministicIntent is voice-only, narrow regex patterns, first match wins, handler returns nil to fall through, no confidence score and no production counter (debug log only). Matches send() and servedDeterministically.

units.key: § Flo — AI Assistant Architecture > 16. AppleToolDispatcher
units.does: Claims AppleToolDispatcher adapts ToolSpecs to FoundationModels tools, reached via AppDependencies.current.providers.appleToolDispatcher, registry set for Apple turns and cleared afterwards.

units.key: § Flo — AI Assistant Architecture > 17. Action Bridges
units.does: Claims email compose stages a draft for MFMailComposeViewController (user sends), contacts add/remove plus list, Tavily web search requiring the user's key, Anthropic server web search alternative.

units.key: § Flo — AI Assistant Architecture > 18. Tests
units.does: Lists test suites PhoneticOverridesTests, TTSTextNormalizerTests, HallucinationFeedbackTests, DeterministicIntentTests, TurnRouterTests, MedicalQueryGuardTests, CoachVoiceGuardTests, FactCatalogValidationTests — all exist in EmuquTests/.

units.key: § Flo — AI Assistant Architecture > 19. Known Gotchas
units.does: no behavioural claim: list of implementation gotchas (MainActor.assumeIsolated, AVAudioConverter Sendable, duplicate tool names, voice fallback, no lexicon API, year spelling, watchdog, cache prefix, whole tool calls).

units.key: § Flo — AI Assistant Architecture > 20. Telemetry
units.does: Claims telemetry goes through debugLog with the listed log line prefixes; Troubleshooting shows warnings/errors. Log formats for usage and deterministic hit match code strings.
